call_input.prompt:
Create a completely new finished flat square Korean recruitment poster, one independent 1:1 artwork only. Do not make a mockup, photographed poster, collage of alternatives, comparison, contact sheet, framed image or multiple panels. Fully opaque background. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력. Ask the current tool and model for its maximum supported native resolution for this square.

The specific content is a chance to bring one small nonelectric household item, examine its state with supplied tools, and decide whether repair is possible. The image and all information must build that participant decision together. This composition is designed from the adjacency of the item to its conditions and of its visible joint to the actual repair scope. Use one small wooden folding tabletop mirror with a slightly loose pivot, viewed close enough to recognize both the complete small object and its screw/support connection. Do not show a successful repair, a pristine after-image, a before/after pair, a tool assortment, icons or a communal scene.

Visual construction: The tabletop mirror occupies a meaningful central-left space within the reading, with its frame extending diagonally toward the center and its wooden support and metal pivot visible. It is not a picture pasted in a top corner. A single slim flathead screwdriver enters the same scene from the right and its blade is visibly seated in the pivot screw slot. The screw is backed out just a little, with a narrow visible washer/gap at the connection, but the screw, bracket, frame and folding support remain physically connected and supported. The viewer must be able to recognize what is being checked. Consistent modest daylight, local contact shadow under the object and support, real wood grain distinct from steel, soft neutral mirror reflection. Do not add separate enlargements, callout drawings, leader arrows, hands, faces, tools, labels, decorative marks or any invented information.

Use a compact first-reading invitation and application relationship: a moderately sized two-line title and its recruitment phrase occupy the upper-left reading area; the complete application deadline and full URL sit directly beside them in a complementary upper-right reading area, at a strong readable scale and contrast. These two parts have similar attention and form one first decision, rather than a giant title separated from a bottom action strip. Place photography consent, participation fee/on-site payment, and contact immediately adjacent to this application area, with enough normal body size and spacing to read them. They belong to the decision to apply.

The one-item bringing sentence and the excluded-item sentence belong directly beside the recognizable complete mirror frame, on the left side above/along its central silhouette. Set these together in a spacious readable measure so the reader relates the pictured small nonelectric object to what may be brought. Let the mirror's silhouette determine the available space and nearby line lengths, while keeping complete text on clear ground, never on the picture.

The tools/parts-cost sentence and the condition-check/non-guarantee sentence belong in a separate nearby measure directly to the right of the mirror's visible pivot and screwdriver contact, occupying clear ground beside that real inspection location. Their adjacency to the actual joint makes the scope of the invitation visible. The long non-guarantee value must use natural word-group breaks into several readable lines, not a single compressed line and not a narrow leftover gap. All conditions must not become one wide detached policy block. They must not all be enlarged into warnings.

Give date, entry/session times, place and age/capacity a coherent arrival-decision grouping beside and below the repair-scope reading area in the lower-right, using the clear space shaped by the object and support. Preserve all details and natural phrase breaks at a useful body size. Keep this group near the other decision information rather than relegating it to tiny footer type. Use optical spacing between actual values to distinguish roles; no new section headings, cards, badges, numbering, grids, rules or decorative symbols. Do not force all content into a fixed vertical sequence.

Typography: crisp real readable Korean sans-serif; compact broad-weight title, confident but moderate invitation/application emphasis, carefully spaced ordinary body. All fourteen exact copy values must remain fully legible in both the native output and an actual 720px-wide view. Natural word-boundary line breaks are essential to avoid tiny lettering. Prefer the text's true meaning and joint/object adjacency over empty margins. Cool pale blue-gray ground with deep forest-black copy and restrained burnt-orange application copy, no paper grain, fake tape, glow, decorative texture or irrelevant effects. A precise editorial still-life photograph integrated into the poster's information space. Do not print any instruction text.

ONLY the following fourteen values may be printed. Render every value exactly ONCE, preserving spelling, spaces, case, numerals, punctuation, the middle dots and time en dash. Line breaks between complete words within a value are allowed without changing the value. No omissions, additions, translation, paraphrases, duplicates, shortened URL or extra headings. Source order below is not a rigid layout template. Do not print the source-list numbers:
1. 고쳐 쓰는 토요일
2. 이웃 수리 작업실 참여자 모집
3. 2026년 12월 5일 토요일
4. 오후 2시–5시 · 입장은 오후 1시 40분부터
5. 하람시 잇는집 2층 · 수선길 12
6. 대상: 만 16세 이상 · 회차별 12명
7. 작은 생활용품 한 점을 가져와 주세요.
8. 전기·배터리 제품과 위험한 물건은 받지 않습니다.
9. 도구는 제공하며 부품 비용은 현장에서 안내합니다.
10. 수리 여부는 상태 확인 후 결정하며 완성을 보장하지 않습니다.
11. 촬영은 동의한 참여자에 한해 진행합니다.
12. 참가비 5,000원 · 현장 결제
13. 12월 2일까지 신청: haram-mend.example/join
14. 문의: 이웃 수리 운영팀

This is a single square poster with all exact copy integrated. The first glance must connect invitation and application; the central object must shape the adjacency of bring/exclusion and joint/repair-scope; arrival and consent/payment/contact must remain readable and meaningful to the decision. No giant isolated title, corner attachment photo, detached broad policy block or fixed bottom application strip.

strengths: Title and recruitment read adjacent to the upper-right complete deadline/URL, with consent, payment and contact directly beneath the application.
Bringing/exclusion are beside the recognizable full mirror; tools/parts cost and state-check/non-guarantee sentences sit beside the pivot and tool contact rather than in one detached policy block.
The enlarged central object creates separate clear measures around its frame, joint and support; natural two/three-line condition breaks remain readable at 720px.
A narrow pivot gap/washer and engaged screwdriver blade are more visible than in the initial version; object contact and surfaces are consistent.

comparison.reason: Better invitation/action first reading, full-object/bring-exclusion relationship, and actual-joint/repair-scope relationship. Fourteen exact values remain readable at native and 720.
tradeoffs: The main mirror photograph is much larger and dominates the thumbnail more than the initial small cue.
Some explanatory and consent text is smaller than the initial wide-line treatment, though still readable at the actual 720px view.

uncertainties: A visible washer/gap suggests the joint being examined, but the real degree of looseness and any physical repair cannot be certified from this generated image.
Visible dash and punctuation were inspected; raster pixels do not prove original Unicode code points.
Maximum supported native resolution was requested only through prompt and is unconfirmed.
Authorship, physical function, actual repair effectiveness and print certification were not verified.
remaining_defects: At 320px the large mirror has strong visual dominance and competes with the intended text-led participant decision.
The intact mirror surface can still look like a polished product image; inspection is conveyed mainly by the joint contact and adjacent scope text rather than visible damage.

ai_slop_observations.glyphs: No visible malformed Hangul, fake microtype, arbitrary logo, extra headings, icons, watermark or duplicate value in native/720 inspection.
ai_slop_observations.structure_material_light: Wooden frame/support and crossbar remain connected with differentiated steel surfaces and consistent contact shadows. The screwdriver blade touches the slotted pivot head. Generic blurred mirror reflection is not claimed as exact real-space reproduction.
ai_slop_observations.composition: Information follows object/joint adjacency and upper invitation/application relationship. The object is central and strongly enlarged, so its visual dominance is recorded as a remaining composition tradeoff.

unverified_scopes: Other outputs, full project quantity, C artifacts, actual other-direction distinction, external review, physical usability and print readiness.
